fieldNotes.location: Geocoded point (ROOFTOP, moved 145m) lands squarely on the large white-roofed plant building in the Utah Industrial Depot (former Tooele Army Depot, built by the Army early 1990s, converted to commercial use by Penske 1996). Confirmed as Detroit Reman West -- the second-largest Detroit Reman plant (~330 workers), per DTNA, Tooele Chamber and Yelp at 100 South Lodestone Way.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter chain-link fencing is visible on multiple building faces, implying controlled access, but Street View coverage at the entrances is sparse (mostly 2015-2018) and shows no barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth. Recorded truckGate=false with the field flagged uncertain -- a gate is plausible for a 330-worker DTNA plant but is not visually confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed; flagged uncertain due to poor Street View coverage.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short direct approaches from the depot road grid to the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 10-25 dock doors along the building's south/SW face; count approximate, partly obscured by parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50: long rows of parked trailers in dedicated drop yards on the south and SW, plus extensive outdoor core/component storage.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on the south and SW sides, separate from the dock apron; consistent with a reman plant holding cores and finished goods.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line/spur runs along a SEPARATE building to the SE, not the Detroit Reman West building. No spur observed reaching this facility -> railServed=false; flagged uncertain given the depot's heavy historical rail network.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Detroit Reman West occupies a single large building (plus attached office). The neighboring large buildings are separate occupants in the industrial depot -> multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: High-desert site in the Utah Industrial Depot outside Tooele, ringed by open desert and mountains -> Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Isolated high-desert location; cellular coverage may be moderate. Tooele city and an active industrial park are nearby, so not extreme -> recorded false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity appears concentrated on the south/SW face -> shipRcvSeparate=false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium: building positively identified, but gate/guard determinations limited by sparse Street View coverage and dock counts partly obscured by trailers.
